parse_latexml_document: parse a LaTeXML BeautifulSoup object into a structured Document with sections, figures, and references
parse_latexml_children_elements: parse LaTeXML HTML children and append them as typed elements to a parent Document element
parse_latexml_citations: parse LaTeXML citation elements and append bracketed references to a parent element
parse_latexml_authors: parse LaTeXML author elements into a Paragraph containing author information
parse_latexml_references: parse LaTeXML bibliography items and add them as references to a Document
